description: Tourism Resilience Index is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA Coastal Storms Program; Mississippi-Alabama Sea Grant Consortium. This self-assessment tool helps business owners or managers check if they are prepared to maintain operations during and after disasters. The guide offers a simple and inexpensive method to predict if tourism businesses are prepared to maintain operations during and after disasters. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal, High Winds, Severe Winter Weather, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Water Quality, Wildfire. Assets: Cultural and Community Services, Economy, People. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
